WMO.long_name: World Meteorological Organization buoy identification number

drogue_lost_date.long_name: Date and time of drogue loss

drogue_status.long_name: Status indicating the presence of the drogue

end_date.long_name: Last good date and time derived by DAC quality control

end_lat.long_name: Last good latitude derived by DAC quality control

end_lon.long_name: Last good longitude derived by DAC quality control

err_sst.comments: Estimated one standard error of near-surface sea water temperature estimate from drifting buoy measurements
err_sst.long_name: Standard uncertainty of fitted sea water temperature

err_sst1.comments: Estimated one standard error of near-surface non-diurnal sea water temperature estimate from drifting buoy measurements
err_sst1.long_name: Standard uncertainty of fitted non-diurnal sea water temperature

err_sst2.comments: Estimated one standard error of near-surface diurnal sea water temperature anomaly estimate from drifting buoy measurements
err_sst2.long_name: Standard uncertainty of fitted diurnal sea water temperature anomaly

flg_sst.long_name: Fitted sea water temperature quality flag

flg_sst1.long_name: Fitted non-diurnal sea water temperature quality flag

flg_sst2.long_name: Fitted diurnal sea water temperature anomaly quality flag

gap.long_name: Time interval between previous and next location

source_obs_start_global.long_name: Derived source provenance index; not a forecast feature

source_traj_index.long_name: Derived source provenance index; not a forecast feature

sst.comments: Estimated near-surface sea water temperature from drifting buoy measurements. It is the sum of the fitted near-surface non-diurnal sea water temperature and fitted diurnal sea water temperature anomaly. Discrepancies may occur because of rounding.

sst1.comments: Estimated near-surface non-diurnal sea water temperature from drifting buoy measurements

sst2.comments: Estimated near-surface diurnal sea water temperature anomaly from drifting buoy measurements
sst2.long_name: Fitted diurnal sea water temperature anomaly

start_date.long_name: First good date and time derived by DAC quality control

start_lat.long_name: Last good latitude derived by DAC quality control

start_lon.long_name: First good longitude derived by DAC quality control

typedeath.comments: 0 (buoy still alive), 1 (buoy ran aground), 2 (picked up by vessel), 3 (stop transmitting), 4 (sporadic transmissions), 5 (bad batteries), 6 (inactive status)

scientific_status: storage consolidation only; no new cleaning, imputation, split, fitted model or accuracy claim

grounding_NA.cutoff_semantics: official last-good time, not observed first-grounding time

drogue_status.contract_mapping: Prior implementation field regime now stored in drogue_status; state semantics and qualification unchanged

hardware_missing.representation: Arrow numeric null; not the literal string NA
hardware_missing.zero_policy: Preserve all recorded zeros; semantics not reinterpreted
hardware_missing.observed_changes: NaN-to-null only; no infinity, negative or finite missing code found
